name: io.github.auscahq/ausca
title: Ausca
description: Pay-per-call APIs and MCP services for agents, no accounts or keys, with verifiable receipts.

environmentVariables.name: AUSCA_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.name: AUSCA_MAX_PAYMENT_USD
